text:
Jamie: Quick idea — pop-up picnic at the plaza Monday 12:30? Bring snacks/games? :sun_with_face:
Olivia: love this. count me in. can someone grab a blanket?
Sam: I can bring a picnic blanket and a speaker (small).
Lee: I'll bring sandwiches (veg + ham). anyone allergic to nuts?
Maya: no nuts for me pls. i'll bring fruit and sparkling water.
Alex: Scrabble set? also down for a short board-game sesh after lunch. :game_die:
Jamie: scrabble + spritzers = perfect. who wants to volunteer to grab napkins/utensils?
Olivia: i'll grab napkins and cups. how many ppl expected?
Jamie: so far 6 but maybe more. let's say 8 max.
Sam: can we do a tiny poll for dietary prefs? quick thumbs up for veg-only, heart for meat ok.
Maya: :thumbsup: (veg-only)
Lee: :heart: (meat ok)
Alex: :thumbsup:
Olivia: :heart:
Jamie: noted — looks like mix. Jamie: also quick park logistics: plaza has benches but bring blankets in case. watch out for the 1pm sprinkler test (it runs on odd days).
lunchbot: Reminder set: "Pop-up picnic @ 1934567890" Monday 12:00 — I'll ping you 30m before.
Sam: thanks @lunchbot :raised_hands:
Olivia: should we move inside if it rains? 2nd-floor cafe has extra tables.
Jamie: good call — backup = 2nd-floor cafe. I'll post update by 11:30 if weather looks bad.
Maya: I'll bring a small first-aid kit and a pack of wet wipes.
Alex: anyone up for a 10-minute scrabble tournament? winner gets a candy bar.
Lee: i'm in. candy bribery accepted. :grin:
Jamie: ok winners sweets budget: $5. i'll bring cash or Venmo.
Olivia: I'll make a quick sign to put on the plaza table: "Redwood Picnic — all welcome"
Sam: see you all monday!
Jamie: thanks everyone — i'll do final recap Sunday night. :calendar:
